news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.30 (down from ₹11.91 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹32.2b (flat on FY 2025). Net income: ₹238.4m (down 89% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 0.7% (down from 6.8% in FY 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 71%. Revenue is forecast to grow 18% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Construction industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 37% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 3% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.8% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
